tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Java Professional / Hybris
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Java and Hybris professional opportunities at Tech Mahindra. With over 5 years of hands-on expertise building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical proficiency in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: API & Integration Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while building robust data pipelines to synchronize catalogs across global enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Cloud & CI/CD Execution
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, ensuring stable platform operations.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, supported by extensive SQL and FlexibleSearch tuning.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your requirements.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my strong Java and SAP Commerce expertise to Tech Mahindra's dynamic engineering teams. My background delivering scalable enterprise solutions for global brands aligns directly with your technical goals in driving robust e-commerce and Java-based implementations.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce and Java enterprise experience to Tech Mahindra to build scalable, high-performance e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Justin, I saw your post regarding Java and Hybris professionals for Tech Mahindra. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce (Hybris) and Java experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Java Professional / Hybris - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Java Professional and Hybris opportunity. With over 5 years of backend development experience specializing in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to Tech Mahindra's engineering initiatives. I am based in Germany with a valid work permit, serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, and available from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
